parts.name: z_motor
parts.desc: Lead-screw stepper hanging under z_motor_plate: its 22 mm pilot locates in the plate's hole, four M3 x 10 from above thread into its own housing. Its shaft is the lead screw leadscrew.
parts.model_source: simulation solid only (no CAD model); 4 x M3 x 4.5 drawn (v12.1)

findings.message: z_motor carries 21.7 N along its screw on joint z (21.3 N of weight, 0.4 N to accelerate 6.52 kg, shared by 3 screws). Its maker states no axial load rating (NOT STATED by the maker (product page: no thrust rating; 'Has Torque/Thrust Curve? No')), so this load is NOT checked against anything.
findings.hint: Ask the maker for the thrust / bearing axial-load rating, keep the load small, or carry the weight on a separate thrust bearing. Do not infer a limit from the holding torque.

parts.placeholder_why: ratings without a maker's source: efficiency, rotor_inertia_gcm2
